summary: UWM Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $400M transferable subscription rights offering. One right per Class A share is distributed October 5, 2026 to holders of record October 2, 2026, with rights trading on the NYSE under UWMC RT through November 11, 2026, expiring November 12, 2026. The subscription price is the greater of $2.00 and 85% of the trailing ten-day VWAP. UWM entered a Backstop Agreement with SFS Group Capital, Mat Ishbia (UWM's CEO, indirectly controlling 75% of SFS Group), and Oaktree-affiliated purchasers: if subscriptions fail to raise $400M, Oaktree has the option and the Ishbia parties are obligated to purchase the unfunded amount. Watch take-up and whether the $2.00 floor prices above market; the CEO/Oaktree backstop signals concentrated insider support but dilutes non-participants.
